update_delayed_memory.description: Allows the model to append selected fields to an existing delayed memory report.
rules: Use this marker only after the user explicitly asks to update an existing delayed memory report or explicitly accepts a proposal to extend one.
The marker appends only tags, body, and long_term_facts_ids to an existing report. It never replaces title, summary, or existing content.
Replace id with the 6-character report id shown in <DELAYED_MEMORY>.
List only new tags, new body content, and the raw L4 ids actually absorbed by this update.
At least one of tags, long_term_facts_ids, or body must be non-empty.
Do not add any other text while updating a report. Immediately emit only the marker.
